messages:
Mina: Quick follow-up from today's KV shard flap postmortem. We need owners for remediation tests: regression promptset, focused load job, and a controlled chaos drill that exercises eviction fallback. Also note recurrence: spikes align with nightly batch writes.

Josh: Sounds good. Immediate = promptset CI guard. Medium = load harness + TTL override. Long = drill + warm-cache policy.

Carla: I'll own promptset. Will extract 5 seeds from traces (cold-start, batch-aligned spike, streaming short, many-small, long-context). PR by Thu EOD.

Sam: I'll own load harness. k6 scenario: ramp 50->1800rps over 10m, optional TTL-override stage via admin API, gated and with kill-switch. Need trace slice for request mix. @Josh attach?

Josh: Trace link: https://redwood.internal/trace/EVT-2026-kv-evict. Snapshot in TICKET-4821. I'll add the batch-window notes.

Mina: Promptset acceptance: detect regressions in CI. Regression = p99 increase >12% OR token cost >1.8x vs baseline. Prompts go in evals/kv-evict/ and run nightly.

Carla: Will add "eviction_fingerprint" metadata and streaming/non-stream variants, plus expected outputs.

Sam: TTL override example to include in job:
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://ops-api.internal/shards/7/override-ttl -d '{"ttl_seconds":20}'
Will gate behind feature flag and staging rehearsal.

ops-bot: Created TICKET-5400 "kv-evict test bundle" assigned Carla, Sam. Due 2026-05-21.

QA-bot: Nightly eval configured: evals/kv-evict runs 03:00 UTC -> #eng-platform on fail.

Mina: Timeline recap: Carla = prompt PR by Thu (TICKET-5401), Sam = load+TTL by Tue (TICKET-5402), Josh = monitoring + dashboards by Mon (TICKET-5403). Tabletop Tue, live drill Wed next sprint. I'll draft post-drill writeup and update postmortem.

Josh: I'll create alerts: sustained cache-miss >4% for 3m -> page SRE; add eviction_fingerprint dashboard.

Carla: Will ping product/solutions for rollout sign-off in PR.

Mina: Thanks all. Keeping thread open until TICKET-5400 moves to In Progress.
